# AgriScanAI

> AgriScanAI is a digital extension support system built by Good Partners (Nairobi, Kenya). It combines AI crop pest and disease identification from photos, local-language advisory (Swahili and more), and farmer data tools that help NGOs, cooperatives, agribusinesses and government programmes run and measure agricultural programmes. The mobile app works offline and in low-connectivity areas; a web dashboard serves organisations.

Contact: info@agriscanai.co.ke · +254 711 085 400 · Marsabit Plaza, Ngong Road, Nairobi, Kenya
